headline: Approved $460,855 contract for airport vehicle wash systems; recommended $1,470,800 SS4A Main Street Signals budget and water excavation contracts.
summary: Public comments asked when safe streets work would start in 2027, how much the Town Meeting TV budget increased, whether the Winooski Valley Police Department gets an annual audit, and about bus schedules. Town Meeting TV gave an update on its FY26 results and its FY28 budget request. The board also approved its meeting schedule through August 2027.
decisions: Approved the October 26, 2026 Board of Finance meeting minutes as part of the consent agenda, which passed unanimously.
Accepted the Winooski Valley Park District annual report and FY28 funding request and placed them on file, as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended that the City Council approve accepting a $50,000 state grant for pavement markings in 2027, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved a contract with Maintenance Tech., Inc. for $460,855 to replace automated vehicle wash systems at the airport, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved the regular schedule of Board of Finance and City Council meetings through August 2027, as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended that the City Council authorize establishing the SS4A Main Street Signals project budget of $1,470,800, with a required local match of $294,000. The motion passed unanimously.

Recommended that the City Council authorize the Director of Public Works to sign on-call contracts with three water resources excavation contractors, up to $500,000 each. The motion passed unanimously.
